description: Turn id: na-, the id of the minutes, and the turn number in that meeting
Date of the meeting YYYY-MM-DD; stored as text
President in office on the date: 김대중, 노무현, 이명박, 박근혜, 문재인, 윤석열, 이재명; an acting presidency is counted with the president it followed
Camp of that president: progressive or conservative; describes the government, not the speaker
Policy area: 국방 (defense), 외교통일 (foreign affairs and unification), 법제사법 (legislation and judiciary), 환경노동 (environment and labor), 보건복지 (health and welfare), 여성가족 (gender equality and family)
Committee name as recorded in the minutes
국정감사 (annual audit of the government), 정기회 (regular session), 임시회 (extraordinary session)
Member's name as printed; in hanja until about 2004
The member's party on the date of the meeting (Korean Wikipedia member lists, with dated switches); 무소속 = independent
Party family: democratic (민주당 계열), conservative (보수 계열), other party, independent
ruling party (the president's party on that date), opposition, or independent
One speaking turn as recorded in the minutes; not preprocessed
